## Enterprise App — Overview

App-level signals from the .NET API and Python data-engine via Application Insights. Time range is controlled by the workbook's default parameter.

content.query:
requests
| summarize count() by bin(timestamp, 1m), cloud_RoleName
| render timechart
content.title: Requests per minute, per role

content.query:
requests
| summarize avg(duration), percentile(duration, 95) by bin(timestamp, 5m), cloud_RoleName
| render timechart
content.title: Latency — avg + p95 (ms)

content.query:
dependencies
| where type in ("Queue", "postgresql", "SQL")
| summarize count(), avg(duration) by type, target
| order by count_ desc
content.title: Dependencies — RabbitMQ + Postgres

content.query:
traces
| where severityLevel >= 3
| summarize count() by bin(timestamp, 5m), cloud_RoleName
| render timechart
content.title: Warning-or-above log volume per role
